overview_description.description:
Bettermode is a computer software company that offers a cloud-based platform empowering the new generation of online communities. It integrates with messengers and social media and helps its users to amplify the vibe around their business by allowing them and their customers to create content.

The company was founded in 2018 and headquartered in Ontario, Canada.

about_short_description.short_description: A powerful community platform integrated into your product. Increase user engagement, retention and lifetime value.

product.name: Bettermode Community Platform
product.description: A modular, cloud-based platform for building and managing online customer communities to centralize engagement, support, and feedback.

product.name: AI Search
product.description: An AI-powered search tool providing fast, personalized search results within the community to improve user engagement.

product.name: AI Moderation
product.description: An AI-based moderation system that automates content review and helps maintain community health with minimal manual effort.

product.name: Analytics & Reports
product.description: Tools providing insights and reports on community engagement, member activity, and content performance to inform decision-making.

product.name: Notifications & Inbox
product.description: A real-time notification system and unified inbox that keeps community members informed and connected.

product.name: API & Webhooks
product.description: APIs and webhooks that enable integration with external tools and automation of workflows within the community platform.
